determinism.scope: Two complete offline builds in separate disposable copies, separated by more than two seconds. Every generated XLSX, CSV and site data snapshot was compared byte-for-byte across both builds and candidate. No generated files were copied back.
determinism.core_date_note: Archive timestamps describe deterministic formatting, not source retrieval or review dates.

full_regression_status: Whole-repository regressions and source-pinned research boundary tests are owned and reported by the integrating parent. This independent report covers canonical validators, conservative evidence guards, actual local JavaScript rendering, deterministic builds and every exported cell/hyperlink.
limitations: Local-only verification; no network, browser, source-page revisit, source refetch, live deployment or publication.
Source package hashes are verified, but independent source-content audits remain separately required. Export correctness does not establish current employment or resolve source conflicts.

The original release24 verifier/report and immutable predecessor remain unchanged; this report is a separate display-only audit. JavaScript rendering uses a minimal local DOM harness, not a visual browser review. XLSX checks use openpyxl and archive inspection, not Microsoft Excel or LibreOffice visual rendering.
Deterministic bytes are verified under the recorded current Python/openpyxl toolchain, not guaranteed across arbitrary future library versions.
Roster records and raw observations are not unique-person or confirmed-current-employment totals. Selected career profiles remain partial evidence, not complete school/category coverage.
